description: Get a referral key for the LLPRO referral program. Bring a customer (agent, business or person) and earn 20% of what they pay LLPRO, net of refunds, for 12 months from their first paid job: every tool, LLPRO Business and subscriptions. Same rule for everyone; a referral never changes ranking. Add ?ref=<key> to links and calls (e.g. https://llpro.ai/mcp?ref=<key>) or send X-LLPRO-Ref. Returns the key and a ledger token shown once. Not paid: self-referral, LLPRO's own network, existing customers; refunds are taken back. Each month is a signed Verified Attribution case. Payouts: USDC on Base or bank transfer, monthly from $10. Testing: a referral earns nothing yet; payouts are in test mode. Terms: https://llpro.ai/referrals.json

payout.description: Optional now: 'usdc-base:0x' + 40 hex (a wallet on Base) or 'bank'.
